title: Owambe Con
brief: Kemi's owambe is tonight, and the Kingmaker's campaign treasurer never misses one. Go in as a rich returnee and come out with his phone.
standout: A con in gold lace at the party of the year.

say.speaker: Eko Crest, evening
lines: Kemi: Darling, tonight you are Adaeze from Houston. You own three care homes.
Amaka: I own a soldering iron.
Kemi: Not tonight you don't. Chin up. Walk slowly. Rich people never hurry.

objectives.text: Cross the party to the treasurer's table

objectives.sub: While he is telling you about his yacht

say.speaker: The treasurer's table
lines: Treasurer: Houston! My cousin is in Houston. You must know him.
Amaka: Everybody knows him. May I see your new phone? My nephew wants that one.
Treasurer: Take, take. The campaign pays for everything.

objectives.text: Leave before he looks for it
objectives.late: He asked for his phone back, and then for security.

say.speaker: Amaka, outside
lines: Amaka: Tunde. The Kingmaker's campaign money. I am looking at all of it.
Amaka: Big Bar pays. It goes through Shina's levies and comes out clean.
Amaka: And the accounts are all in one place. Crestline Bank.
Tunde: Then we know where to go.
